shortDescription: Manage administrators in the Meraki cloud

options.name: auth_key
options.description: Authentication key provided by the dashboard. Required if environmental variable C(MERAKI_KEY) is not set.

options.name: email
options.description: Email address for the dashboard administrator. Email cannot be updated. Required when creating or editing an administrator.

options.name: host
options.description: Hostname for Meraki dashboard. Can be used to access regional Meraki environments, such as China.

options.name: internal_error_retry_time
options.description: Number of seconds to retry if server returns an internal server error.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the dashboard administrator. Required when creating a new administrator.

options.name: networks
options.description: List of networks the administrator has privileges on. When creating a new administrator, C(org_name), C(network), or C(tags) must be specified.

options.name: org_access
options.description: Privileges assigned to the administrator in the organization.

options.name: org_name
options.description: Name of organization. Used when C(name) should refer to another object. When creating a new administrator, C(org_name), C(network), or C(tags) must be specified.

options.name: output_format
options.description: Instructs module whether response keys should be snake case (ex. C(net_id)) or camel case (ex. C(netId)).

options.name: output_level
options.description: Set amount of debug output during module execution.

options.name: rate_limit_retry_time
options.description: Number of seconds to retry if rate limiter is triggered.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or modify, or delete an organization If C(state) is C(absent), name takes priority over email if both are specified.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags the administrator has privileges on. When creating a new administrator, C(org_name), C(network), or C(tags) must be specified. If C(none) is specified, C(network) or C(tags) must be specified.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time to timeout for HTTP requests.

options.name: use_https
options.description: If C(no), it will use HTTP. Otherwise it will use HTTPS. Only useful for internal Meraki developers.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.
